scope: Gazebo Harmonic + ROS2 Jazzy + original RL; isolated domains, no git commit/push

actual_scenarios.note: 0.4m box moving at 0.18m/s; added after robot advanced 0.35m; box truth diagnostic only
original warehouse/map; this test has no box contact logger and does not prove all furniture contact absence

limitations: finite single-box tests, not arbitrary moving objects
short-term constant velocity estimate; occlusion and view changes may cause missing/false tracks
20cm lateral inscribed radius is user-selected and not a full gait envelope
persistent blockage verified with mocked Nav2, not a physically enclosed Gazebo robot
no SLAM or learned locomotion changes
final_controller: AvoidanceController: native MPPI en route, native RPP goal approach within 0.65m; RPP first-path search 1000m to support late handoff
